Finally, it is essential that the international community collaborate in such a way that respects and protects human rights during pandemics. Global cooperation mechanisms, transnational aid and knowledge exchange can assist all countries, particularly those at high risk with limited resources, to implement public health measures without needlessly sacrificing human rights principles (Hansen, 2020). Even though an outbreak requires extraordinary measures, fundamental human rights principles must always remain at the heart of any policy decisions made during a pandemic outbreak.
